g.text: Two applications of the same card are targeted.
The card must support several logical channels in parallel.
select application (aid #1) on the basic channel
- card image of application #1, on the basic channel
- card image of application #2, on its own channel
read record (contract list) on the basic channel
The other application stays active meanwhile:
no new selection is needed to come back to it.
read record (event log) on the additional channel
Closing a logical channel deactivates the matching card image only.
The application selected on the basic channel remains usable.
